sentences.text:
Author: Suvra Ghosh
Bench: Suvra Ghosh
12.06.2024 rc/ct.no.34 Item No.25 Crr No. 2192 of 2024

In the matter of : Vishwanath Prasad Singh & Anr.
.. ..petitioners Mr. Sourav Chatterjee Mr. Supriyo Gole Mr. Soumya Nag Mr. Aditya Tiwary Mr.
Subhadeep Adhikary ...for the Petitioners

The petitioners seek quashing of proceedings of Case No.
CN/950/2018 under Sections 406/418/420/120B of the Indian Penal Code pending before the learned Metropolitan Magistrate, 19th Court at Calcutta primarily on three-fold grounds :-
First, the provisions under Section 202 of the Code of Criminal Procedure had not been complied with.

Second, since admittedly part payment has been made by the petitioners, there is no ingredient of offence under Section 420 and 406 of the Indian Penal Code against the petitioners and third, the alleged due payment has been taken care of by the scheme of compromise and arrangement between the parties which has been approved by the National Company Law Tribunal, Mumbai Bench-IV.

entities.text: National Company Law Tribunal, Mumbai Bench-IV
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Upon consideration of the submission made on behalf of the petitioners as well as material on record, this Court is of the view that the petitioners have been able to make out an arguable case.
Petitioners are directed to serve copy of the application along with annexure thereto upon the opposite parties and file affidavit of service on the adjourned date.

Let this matter appear under the heading "Contested Application" on August 28,
2024.

All further proceedings of the Case No. CN/950/2018 under Sections 406/418/420/120B of the Indian Penal Code pending before the learned Metropolitan Magistrate, 19th Court at Calcutta be stayed till August 31, 2024 or until further orders, whichever is earlier.

(Suvra Ghosh,J)
